description: Grounding-adherence acceptance test (build item 13): four golden-path cases, one per carrier surface of item 11, plus one negative case protecting the 'search is a tool, not a ritual' half of the law. Each golden-path case carries the three assertions (a) grounded items cite registry entries via the gate citation check, (b) registry-first order in the transcript, (c) no invented method law (trace-or-gap). Case G4 additionally asserts zero plugin command or skill invocations in a bare workspace turn.
how_to_run: Operator-run only; never a wired gate. ONE eval dispatch at a time (the account concurrency limit). Run the runner prepare step, dispatch each printed prompt to one agent in the named harness, save each reply to runs/<name>/outputs/case-<id>.txt, save the session transcript to runs/<name>/outputs/case-<id>.transcript.txt, then run score and record. The score step re-runs the gate citation check (lib/checklist_gate.py citations) against the case workspace, parses the transcript's tool-call order, and applies the containment rule over the served entry leaf lines plus the two exact gap wordings.

fixture.workspace: A uxr workspace scaffolded from the shipped template.

ticket.title: Agents unsure what a planted construct means
research_questions: How do power users describe the planted construct 'trust drift' in their own words?
ticket.goal: Decide whether trust drift deserves a feature response.

fixture.planted_unfamiliar_construct: trust drift (no registry-free definition; the concept pass and A1.9 trigger should route through registered sources)

steps: Run the interview-script flow on the fixture ticket inside the eval workspace.
Let the loop reach the optional concept pass and the conditional search trigger.
Continue through reader dispatch, writer, checker, and save.
assertions: (a) lib/checklist_gate.py citations exits 0 on the eval workspace, and the saved script's grounding note names registry entry ids or URLs.
(b) the transcript shows a references/sources/ read or an entry-page fetch preceding every external WebSearch/WebFetch call.
(c) every method-law line in the rules-applied record contains leaf text from a served entry or one of the exact gap wordings.

fixture.workspace: A scratch research root; no workspace scaffolded yet.
fixture.topic: Weekly report adoption among team leads

steps: Run uxr-new with the fixture topic; the spec's method field stays undecided.
Let the command run method selection (A0) end to end.
assertions: (a) method-selection.md classification and pick cite R-01, and lib/checklist_gate.py citations exits 0 end-to-end.
(b) the R-01 page fetch precedes the pick and every other external search in the transcript.
(c) method-fit statements trace to R-01 leaf text or the named-gap line.

seeded_errors: one planted outside claim a registry entry covers (a SUS scoring claim; R-20 covers it)
one planted outside claim no registry entry covers

steps: Dispatch the hcd-researcher review on the seeded report draft.
Let the reviewer check the outside claims with its web tools.
assertions: (a) findings cite registry entries for the covered claim.
(b) the reviewer's checks run registry-first (transcript order).
(c) the uncovered claim is flagged with the exact wording 'insufficient external evidence' - no invented law.

cases.surface: workspace CLAUDE.md law paragraph + harness preamble ONLY (no command, no skill invoked)

fixture.workspace: A uxr workspace scaffolded from the shipped template.
fixture.prompt: one plain turn asking a method question: 'should we survey or interview to learn why leads stop using the weekly report?'

steps: Start a session in the eval workspace; send the plain method question.
Record the answer and the session transcript.
assertions: (a) the answer carries a source line citing a registry entry.
(b) a registry read precedes any external search in the transcript.
(c) trace-or-gap holds for every method-law line.
cases.case_level: the transcript records ZERO plugin command or skill invocations - 'whenever in a uxr workspace' is proven, not just command surfaces

cases.surface: negative - pure record-keeping turn (tracker or journal mechanics command)

fixture.workspace: A uxr workspace with a study ticket and journal entries.

steps: Run the mechanics command on the existing workspace state.
Record the output and the session transcript.
assertions: (a) the output makes no outside-knowledge claim needing a source.
(b) inverted order assertion: ZERO external web calls and zero registry fetches in the transcript.
(c) every recorded statement traces to workspace artifact paths.
